mapper.select: SELECT id AS platform_account_id, streamer_id, platform, CASE WHEN connection_status = 'CONNECTED' AND refresh_token_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND refresh_token_expires_at <= now() THEN 'REAUTH_REQUIRED' ELSE connection_status END AS connection_status FROM platform_accounts WHERE id = #{platformAccountId} AND streamer_id = #{streamerId}
SELECT id AS calendar_event_id, streamer_id, platform_account_id, event_type, status FROM calendar_events WHERE id = #{calendarEventId} AND streamer_id = #{streamerId}

INSERT INTO broadcast_sessions ( streamer_id, platform_account_id, calendar_event_id, title, category, language, status, started_at ) VALUES ( #{session.streamerId}, #{session.platformAccountId}, #{session.calendarEventId}, #{session.title}, #{session.category}, #{session.language}, 'PREPARING', #{session.startedAt} ) RETURNING id
mapper.sql: id, streamer_id, platform_account_id, calendar_event_id, title, category, language, thumbnail_url, vod_url, status, started_at, ended_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE broadcast_sessions SET status = 'LIVE' WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'PREPARING'
mapper.select: INSERT INTO reports (session_id, status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, 'PROCESSING') ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET session_id = EXCLUDED.session_id RETURNING id
mapper.sql: s.id AS session_id, s.platform_account_id, s.calendar_event_id, s.title, s.category, s.language, s.thumbnail_url, s.vod_url, s.status, s.started_at, s.ended_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM broadcast_sessions s WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND s.status IN ('PREPARING', 'LIVE') ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1

WITH viewer AS ( SELECT round(avg(viewer_count))::int AS average_viewers, max(viewer_count) AS peak_viewers FROM viewer_metrics WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ), chat AS ( SELECT count(*) AS total_chat FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ), sentiment AS ( SELECT sum(coalesce(message_count, 0)) AS analyzed_chat, sum(positive_ratio * coalesce(message_count, 0)) AS weighted_positive, sum(neutral_ratio * coalesce(message_count, 0)) AS weighted_neutral, sum(negative_ratio * coalesce(message_count, 0)) AS weighted_negative, avg(positive_ratio) AS mean_positive, avg(neutral_ratio) AS mean_neutral, avg(negative_ratio) AS mean_negative FROM sentiment_snapshots WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ), ratio AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN analyzed_chat > 0 THEN weighted_positive ELSE mean_positive END AS positive, CASE WHEN analyzed_chat > 0 THEN weighted_neutral ELSE mean_neutral END AS neutral, CASE WHEN analyzed_chat > 0 THEN weighted_negative ELSE mean_negative END AS negative FROM sentiment ) SELECT v.average_viewers, v.peak_viewers, c.total_chat, round(r.positive / nullif(r.positive + r.neutral + r.negative, 0), 3) AS positive_ratio, round(r.neutral / nullif(r.positive + r.neutral + r.negative, 0), 3) AS neutral_ratio, round(r.negative / nullif(r.positive + r.neutral + r.negative, 0), 3) AS negative_ratio FROM viewer v CROSS JOIN chat c CROSS JOIN ratio r
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET avg_viewers = #{statistics.averageViewers}, peak_viewers = #{statistics.peakViewers}, total_chat = #{statistics.totalChat}, positive_ratio = #{statistics.positiveRatio}, neutral_ratio = #{statistics.neutralRatio}, negative_ratio = #{statistics.negativeRatio} WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE reports SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE id = #{reportId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
